instances.title: My instances
instances.subtitle: Each instance is an isolated dsh environment
instances.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3–32 characters.
instances.versionHint: Which dsh build the instance runs; the list shows every published version.
instances.versionEmpty: No image version has been published yet — ask an admin.
instances.diskHint: A hard limit: once full, the instance can no longer write. Ask an admin for more space.
instances.newDescription: Pick a subdomain — that becomes its address.
instances.emptyHint: Create one and you get an isolated dsh environment.
instances.deleteDescription: The container and address for “{{slug}}” will be removed. Data and its ownership record are retained. Recreating the same subdomain creates a separate data filesystem; recovery requires operator verification.
instances.deleteFailed: Could not delete the instance, please retry
instances.purgeDescription: This also removes the data filesystem for “{{slug}}” — its workspace, config and plugins are gone for good. This cannot be undone.

instanceDetail.loadFailed: Instance not found, or not yours
instanceDetail.upgradeHint: Upgrading snapshots your data first, then swaps the image — the instance is offline while it runs (longer with more data). If the new version fails to start it rolls back automatically.
instanceDetail.noStable: No other versions are available right now.
instanceDetail.rollbackTitle: Roll back to the previous version?
instanceDetail.rollbackDescription: The data for “{{slug}}” is restored to the moment before the upgrade — anything written since is lost. The image goes back to {{image}}.
instanceDetail.usageStopped: The instance is not running — no live CPU or memory, but disk usage still shows.
instanceDetail.usageEmpty: No samples yet — it samples once a minute.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices signed in to your account
sessions.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the session, please retry

members.title: Members
members.description: People with access to your instances

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.description: All users and instances. Admins can ban, set quotas, inspect status and read container logs — but cannot browse the /data filesystem inside a user's instance.

users.title: Users
users.banDescription: {{email}} will be signed out immediately and can no longer sign in.
users.grantAdminConfirm: Make {{email}} a platform admin? Admins can ban accounts, change quotas, and see every instance and container log.
users.selfDemoteHint: This is your own account: you will lose admin access immediately and be sent back to the home page.

instances.title: Instances
instances.logHint: Container logs may contain user content — visible for troubleshooting, but admins still cannot browse an instance's /data filesystem.
instances.imageHint: Changing the image snapshots the data first, then rebuilds the container — the instance is offline while it runs (longer with more data). If the new image fails to start it rolls back automatically.
instances.imageRollbackConfirm: Roll back to {{image}}? Data written since the upgrade is lost.
instances.imageLocalEmpty: No other images on the host yet
instances.quotaHint: Changing CPU, memory or process limit rebuilds the container — a few seconds of downtime. Growing disk needs no restart; shrinking does. No data is lost.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: dsh versions your users can create and upgrade to. Publish one and it appears in the version picker on their instances.
versions.warmedHint: Cached on this host — the first instance on this version won't wait for a download
versions.unpublishDefault: The default version can't be unpublished — set another version as default first
versions.unpublishConfirm: {{ref}} disappears from the user-facing version picker; instances already running it are unaffected.
versions.notOnHost: Not cached on this host; it downloads automatically the first time a user creates this version
versions.emptyBody: Users can't create instances right now. Check for updates to read the registry, then publish the version you want.
